summary: This Form 6-K filing by United Microelectronics Corporation (UMC) contains the company's reviewed consolidated interim financial statements for the three-month periods ended March 31, 2026 and 2025, along with an independent auditors' review report. The filing is a routine periodic financial report by a foreign private issuer, with no mention of any transaction, corporate action, or event that would classify it as a special situation. There are no deal terms, stakeholder changes, or unusual corporate developments disclosed. The document represents a standard quarterly financial update with no risk-arb or event-driven implications.
